summary: PHASE116 tested a two-step autonomous chain: queue NONE to generated action, then generated action to execution.
proven: Builder can start from queue NONE
Builder can generate a queued executable move through its internal chain
Builder can execute the generated queued move in the next runtime call
queue returns to NONE after execution
finding: Self-need detection is stale: it still reports NEED_DECISION_TO_ACTION_ENGINE after later phases already built that capability.
